item.title: Portland 2027 Worlds: tickets on sale, and your bucket list
item.description:
The world's best disc golfers will descend on Portland, Oregon, June 16–20, 2027, for five days of championship competition at the PDGA Pro Worlds — and tickets are now on sale, with fans encouraged to start planning their trips. Alongside the announcement, the Disc Golf Pro Tour published a Portland bucket list of things to do around the event, framing Worlds as a destination week rather than just a tournament.

For fans, the practical news is simple: tickets are live and Portland in June is a big trip worth booking early. Worlds is the sport's biggest stage, and the early ticket launch — more than seven months out — signals the DGPT expects strong demand. If you're thinking about going, now is the moment to start planning.

Sources

  • Disc Golf Pro Tour: The Road to Portland Starts Here: 2027 PDGA Pro Worlds Tickets Now on Sale!
  • Disc Golf Pro Tour: Beyond the Fairways: Your Portland Worlds Bucket List

item.title: Infinite Discs' Black Friday week 2: all Innova discs on sale
item.description:
Infinite Discs' month-long Black Friday event is in week two, and this week's featured brand is Innova: every Innova disc on the site is discounted, with the savings applied automatically at checkout.

It's a good window to stock up on the classics — Aviars, Leopards, Eagles — or the workhorse drivers like Destroyers, Wraiths, and Mambas, plus newer molds like the Rollo, Arachnid, and Fox. If you've been eyeing a bag refresh, this is the cheapest week of the month to do it with the sport's biggest manufacturer.

Sources

  • Infinite Discs Blog: Black Friday (All November) Week 2: Innova
